key_insight: Swarmlet couples GPU-resident vortex-particle aerodynamics with multirotor flight dynamics and control, preserving wake impulse while scaling to a 100-quadrotor demonstration.
engineering_relevance: The solver supports unsteady rotor-wake and vehicle-interaction studies for multirotor design, flight control, and swarm operation.
method: Meshless reformulated vortex particle LES with compact-support cores and a treecode far field free of regularization error.
Dynamic eddy viscosity via core spreading, with corrected exchange and strength relaxation conserving total vorticity and linear impulse.
Three rotor-model fidelities coupled to six-degree-of-freedom vehicles and flight control, with connected circulation shedding.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports agreement with direct summation to 5×10⁻⁷, third-order time convergence, uncalibrated hover thrust within 2%, calibrated thrust and torque within 3.2%, and near-wake relative L² differences of 0.08–0.21 against PIV.
watch_item: The 100-quadrotor case uses a coarser setting and demonstrates scale, not experimentally validated swarm-level accuracy.
paper_title: Swarmlet: a GPU-resident reformulated vortex particle method for coupled multirotor aerodynamics and flight dynamics
